payload.comment: Ingestion stage is clean. PathMNIST (9-class, 3-channel, 28×28 RGB MedMNIST distribution) loaded with split sizes (train 89 996 / val 10 004 / test 7 180) matching the official manifest exactly; no subsampling. Archive MD5 and SHA-256 are present and the verified MD5 matches the recorded value, confirming integrity. All nine tissue-type labels are consistent with the PathMNIST task definition. The test-domain note correctly flags that CRC-VAL-HE-7K test images originate from a different clinical center, which is an important OOD context for downstream interpretation but is properly documented and does not constitute a defect. Deterministic findings list is empty. One minor traceability observation: llm_model_digest is null for the qwen3.8 Ollama model, meaning the exact model weights/checksum are not pinned in the run manifest. This does not block ingestion but should be addressed before any LLM-assisted stage if full reproducibility is required. No critical or warning-level issues detected; proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (Ollama); model weights are not checksum-pinned in the run manifest, weakening full reproducibility of any LLM-assisted downstream step.
